verdict.rationale: Godot is a locally run, MIT-licensed game engine with no account or hosted-API credential system, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is outside this product category. The only hosted API in the evidence, the Asset Library JSON API, is explicitly keyless, so no credential-issuing capability exists that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
